name: Joshua Idehen (Live) at Plano B
description: Experience a live performance from the British-Nigerian poet and musician at one of Porto's most classic nightclubs. Plano B offers multiple rooms with different vibes to continue the party.
longDescription:
On October 2, 2026, Plano B hosts a live performance by Joshua Idehen, the British-Nigerian poet, musician, and spoken word artist. Idehen is known for his collaborations with artists such as The Comet Is Coming, Sons of Kemet, and Daedelus, and for his solo work which blends poetry with electronic music and jazz influences. His performances often explore themes of identity, migration, and urban life.

Attendees can expect a dynamic live show within the distinctive atmosphere of Plano B. The venue, a long-standing fixture in Porto's nightlife, is recognized for its multi-room layout, each offering a different musical focus and ambiance. The event is categorized as nightlife, suggesting a later start time and an audience primarily interested in music and dancing.

Entry to the event requires an entry fee. Plano B is located in the city center, a short walk from the Aliados metro station.
